answers.longAnswer: At Midato, the frontend build was using Webpack, and the feedback loop had become pretty slow. The CI build was taking about eight minutes, which is a long time when people are trying to make a change, get feedback, and move on to the next thing. I moved the project and its CI workflow over to Vite. The clearest result was that the GitHub Actions build dropped to about two minutes, and local development felt much faster as well. I like this example because it was not really about chasing a new tool. It was about removing friction for the team. I would still want to prepare a better deep dive on the exact migration issues, how we measured the result, and the rollback plan before using it in a very detailed interview discussion.
